hml.text: Eron the Relentless steals a dark magic book from Grandmother Sengir's library for the Savant Bernatheen and asks that the last spell in it be cast on him, and the spell makes him immortal and immune to aging. He declares himself King of the Goblins at Koskun Keep, is killed and rises again, and the goblins accept him as king.
Eron forms a treaty with Aysen to keep his subordinates from invading in exchange for trade of food and goods, declaring a truce in which Aysen feeds his band and they do not kill them.
Joven and Chandler trick Eron into giving them his prized Ebony Rhino, and Eron swears Joven's death will be legendary if caught on his side of Strongrock, though Joven still sneaks into Koskun Keep.
